name: ai-manager
description: Reports Claude Code sessions, agents and work packages to the local ai-manager daemon (aimd).

token.title: aimd token
token.description: The contents of ~/.ai-manager/token, sent to aimd as X-AIM-Token.

band.title: Plan band
band.description: Show the plan band above the prompt.

appendConventions.title: Append package conventions
appendConventions.description: Add the package, branch and PR conventions to agent briefs.

prCheck.title: PR body check
prCheck.description: Ask agents to add the Plan: line to PR bodies before creating a PR.

requirePlanRow.title: Require the plan row
requirePlanRow.description: Refuse to spawn an agent whose brief names a package its registered plan file has no row for, until the row is added. Off: the spawn goes ahead, the package shows as provisional, and the lead is told to add the row.
